residences.note: Head, 47, born Italy, naturalized, owned home valued $850; not working; wife Grace runs a general grocery store. [R4-S1]

bio: In 1940 Joseph DiBiasi, 47, an Italian-born naturalized citizen, owned the house at 1015 Bunker Hill Street, where his wife Grace (Petrillo) kept a general grocery. James DiBiasi, 45, born in Italy, owned the other half of the same house number ([R4-S1]). The FamilySearch tree gives Joseph's dates as 18 Apr 1891 – 31 May 1958. It makes him a son of Giovanni Pasquale DiBiasi and Rosa Siconolfi, which is impossible on Rosa's age; that would also make Grace his niece ([R4-S2]). His real parents are unknown. A widowed Vincenzo DiBiasi (b. c.1866) at 1022 Bunker Hill Street in 1940 is a candidate father. Grace's 1943 repatriation shows Joseph was still an alien when they married, before Sept 1922.
